title: Better Blazecake Recipe
description: this project adds a new recipe for blaze cakes from the create mod.
body: Adds a simple Create mixer recipe for crafting Blaze Cake Base using wheat flour, sugar, cinder flour, and water inside a heated basin with 250 mb of water. This recipe gives Blaze Cake production a more natural Create-style progression, making the process feel like it belongs with other mixing and heating mechanics. Instead of relying only on the default crafting flow, players can produce Blaze Cake Base through a basin setup that matches Create’s automation-focused gameplay. It is useful for modpacks or servers that want Blaze Cake crafting to involve fluids, heat, and mechanical processing while staying clean, lightweight, and easy to understand.![made blazecake base using recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ec0270616ed30d4c4457f029272416fda9adacfc.png)
